item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00005","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C09","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 is a direct and material drafting antecedent: the child expressly includes it in the chain of modifications, retains the same 45,656,420-pound long-staple-cotton quota, uses the August 1 quota year established by C05, and follows the same machinery of modifying the September 5, 1939 proclamation. C09 and C25 are also strong antecedents because the child's proviso reuses their unusually specific 1,500,000-pound harsh-or-rough-cotton category and exclusions, but C05 supplies the more immediate governing framework for the child's operative allocation.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the total quantity of 45,656,420 pounds of cotton having a staple of 11/8 inches or more in length which may be entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption during the year beginning August 1, 1958, and in any subsequent year beginning August 1","parent_excerpt":"the quota year for cotton having a staple length of 11/a inches or more shall hereafter commence on August 1","explanation":"C05 established the August 1 quota-year framework that the child directly carries forward."},{"child_excerpt":"I hereby further modify the said proclamation of September 5, 1939","parent_excerpt":"do hereby further modify the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of September 5, 1939","explanation":"Both use the same operative mechanism—further modification of the foundational 1939 cotton-quota proclamation."},{"child_excerpt":"of the total quantity of 45,656,420 pounds of cotton","parent_excerpt":"limiting imports of cotton having a staple length of 1 1/8 inches or more to an annual quota of 45,656,420 pounds","explanation":"The child preserves C05's precise quota and reorganizes it into staple-length subquotas."},{"child_excerpt":"not more than 1,500,000 pounds shall consist of harsh or rough cotton (except cotton of perished staple, grabbots, and cotton pickings), white in color","parent_excerpt":"1,500,000 pounds of harsh or rough cotton (except cotton of perished staple, grabbots, and cotton pickings), white in color","explanation":"This distinctive language, appearing in C09 and C25, shows that the child also incorporated material from the earlier supplemental-quota lineage."}]}
